name: חֲזִיאֵל
gloss: vision of God; or God has seen
summary: A Levite of the Gershonites, son of Shimei, head of a father's house of Ladan in David's day (1Ch 23:9). The name is חזה with אֵל; whether its first part is a noun “vision” or the verb “has seen” the form does not show, and scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, וַחֲזִיאֵל, and Haran, three.”
